public_obligation.independently_decidable_fact: The unmodified trigger literal has the expected value. Source-level identifier repair can preserve that value without weakening the validator.

failure_class.mechanism: Raw-text regex identifier adaptation rewrites string literals before native evaluation, so final_answer_checks rejects a correct intended result that preprocessing has corrupted.
not_claimed: The final-answer checker itself is not wrong to reject the corrupted candidate.
Max-step termination and its explicit max_steps_error state are legitimate behavior.
No unchecked fallback false-success claim is made.
No live-model or benchmark improvement is predicted.

expected_original: Both triggers: changed literal appears in code_action, native producer logs/state and check argument; check returns false; native max_steps=1 produces max_steps_error with the frozen fallback. Both controls retain their specified native behavior.
expected_intervention: Both triggers: only true variable Name spans can be renamed; intended literal reaches the same validator, passes, and native RunResult reports success on the first action. Both controls retain their specified native behavior.

primary_oracle.trigger_criteria: For each trigger, require the exact frozen response script and allowed call shape, native CodeAgent and LocalPythonExecutor, max_steps=1, normal Python optimization level 0, and one checker invocation. Unexpected calls, exhaustion, import failures or unexpected exceptions are INCONCLUSIVE.
primary_oracle.wrong_decision_criteria: On original source, require the predicted altered literal in the actual action code plus native producer observations/state and check argument; require false check, is_final_answer=false on that action, and actual native RunResult.state=max_steps_error. This is avoidable loss of a valid source-level result caused by framework preprocessing, not success inferred from fallback text.
primary_oracle.intervention_criteria: On patched source with the identical script, require the intended unchanged literal as native producer/check value, true check, actual action is_final_answer=true, native state=success and exact output, with one model call. Merely stopping with an exception is not a repair.
primary_oracle.control_criteria: c_successful_assignment_repair must execute the repaired assignment and succeed on both variants. c_execution_and_check_failure_recovery must retain actual execution-error then check-rejection then valid acceptance on both variants, exactly as specified in its expectation.
primary_oracle.joint_decision: The primary prediction is supported only if both trigger chains and both controls meet their criteria. OBSERVED in fixture JSON means evidence was collected, not that the prediction passed.

local_intervention_description.change: Parse source to identify actual final_answer Name stores and direct calls. When repair is needed, replace only non-call-target Name spans using UTF-8 byte offsets, back to front. Retain literal data, comments, attributes and original formatting.
local_intervention_description.unchanged_consumers: Native local executor, final-answer tool, final_answer_checks, run loop, configured budgets and result state calculation remain the same.
local_intervention_description.scope_limit: One local candidate intervention; no claim of global minimality, universal Python renaming correctness or namespace-collision resolution.

dependencies.version_contract: Python >=3.10, optimization level 0, POSIX SIGALRM for the fixture deadline
native_packages: smolagents from the root-selected src path
dependencies.selection: Set PYTHONPATH to the selected original or patched checkout src. Keep fixture.py and prediction.json together. No fixture flag or environment variable chooses behavior by arm.
dependencies.provider_contract: At most four responses in a case; code_action requires one positional list of native ChatMessage objects plus the exact stop_sequences keyword list; max_steps_fallback requires one such positional list and no keywords. Unused suffixes are allowed. Exhaustion or any shape mismatch is INCONCLUSIVE.
dependencies.resource_contract: Only fixed trusted code with assignments, print, final_answer and one ValueError. No tool subprocesses. Native code timeout 10 seconds; fixture alarm 110 seconds; root total timeout must be <=120 seconds.
dependencies.environment: Offline model stub; suppress telemetry and dotenv loading. An audit hook blocks dotenv reads, socket connections/name resolution and external commands; any resulting import failure is INCONCLUSIVE. No credentials are requested or inspected.

limitations: Prediction and intervention are static and unexecuted; there is no claimed observed effect.
Both target cases are constructed inputs, not samples of real model behavior or prevalence estimates.
The upstream maximum-step tests explicitly expect fallback output after failed checks; that behavior is not scored as a defect.
The fixture observes native result state plus producer/check facts and does not infer acceptance from raw text, exit code alone or its own expected-answer field.
No claim about all Python syntax, separate scopes, dynamically rebound functions, preexisting final_answer_variable collisions, f-string transformations, or remote executors.
The root must freeze all records before executing this file. No target imports, examples, tests or fixture execution occurred during diagnosis.
